item.title: Installing the Python3 and Go Kernels in Jupyter
item.description: Earlier we mentioned that Jupyter Notebook is an interactive notebook that supports running more than 40 programming languages and is very well suited to teaching. Recently, while learning the Go language, I thought of Jupyter. This article mainly describes how to install the Python3 and Go kernels inside Jupyter. 1.
